annotations.title: Amen, amen.
annotations.text: [1] What is it (ſaith S. Auguſtine vpon this place) when our Lord ſaith, Amen, amen? He doth much commend and vrge the thing that he ſo vttereth, doubling it. It is a certaine othe of his, if a man may ſo ſay. for Amen in Hebrue ſignifieth verum, a truth. Yet is it not tranſlated, whereas it might haue been ſaid, verum, verum dico vobis. but neither the [2] Greeke interpreter durſt doe it, nor the Latin. the Hebrue word hath remained ſtil, that ſo it might be the more eſteemed. Tract. 41 in Ioan. By which vvordes and the like [3] recorded in other places of this new Teſtament, the Reader may ſee great reaſon, why we alſo ſay, Amen, amen, and durſt not tranſlate it and ſuch like wordes into our Engliſh tongue.
